simple.meaning: properly, to twist or whirl (in a circular or spiral manner), i.e. (specifically) to dance , to writhe in pain (especially of parturition) or fear ; figuratively, to wait , to pervert
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חוּל (H2342) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.full: H2342. chuwl I. חוּל [ חִיל ] verb whirl, dance, writhe (Late Hebrew, Aramaic id., dance ; Arabic change, turn ; Assyrian —îlu , writhe in fear Dl Pr 191 (on — = see DHM ZK i. 357 ); on form of Hebrew verb see Nö ZMG. 1883, 536 ) — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular חָ֫לָה Micah 1:12 2 t.; וְחָלָה֫ consecutive Hosea 11:6 ; חַלְתִּי Isa 23:4 ; חָ֫לוּ Jer 5:3 (but see below), Lam 4:6 ; וְחָלוּ֫ Deut 2:25 ; חַ֫לְנוּ Isa 26:18 ; Imperfect יָחוּל Jer 23:19 ; 30:23 ; 3 feminine singular תָּחוּל Ezek 30:16 Qr (Kt Co תחיל ); וַתָּחֹ֑ל Jer 51:29 ; אחולה 4:19 Kt (Qr אוֺחִילָה , Hiph`il יחל ); יָחֻ֫לוּ 2Sam 3:29 ; but also יָחִיל Psa 55:5 ( Job 20:21 see II. חול ); וַיָּ֫חֶל 1Sam 31:3 = 1Chr 10:3 + Gen 8:10 (where read probably וַיִּיָּ֫חֶל as 8:12 ; = וַיְיַחֵל Ol Di); 3 feminine singular תָּחִיל Isa 26:17 2 t. + Ezek 30:16 Kt (compare above ); וַתָּ֑חֶל Psa 97:4 ; 2 feminine singular תְּחִלִין Isa 45:10 ; וָחִילוּ Psa 77:17 + 3t. ( 10:5 see II. חול ); וַיָּחִ֫ילוּ Judg 3:25 ; יְחִילוּן Isa 13:8 ; תָּחִ֫ילוּ Jer 5:22 ; Imperative feminine singular חוּ֫לִי Micah 4:10 ; Psa 114:7 ; masculine plural חִילוּ 96:9 ; 1Chr 16:30 ; Infinitive construct (לָ)חוּל Judg 21:21 ; Ezek 30:16 ( = Infinitive absolute); Participle feminine singular חוֺלָה Jer 4:31 see Gf Gie and Ges § 72 R. 1; — 1 dance Judg 21:21 ( בַּמְּחֹלוֺת לָחוּל ). 2 twist, writhe: a. in pain , especially childbirth Isa 26:17 ; 45:10 ׳מַהתֿח (|| מהתֿוליד ; metaphor, of sea 23:4 (|| ילד ); Israel 26:18 (|| חרה ), 54:1 (|| ילד ); Zion 66:7-8 , (|| id. ), Micah 4:10 (|| גֹּ֫חִי , simile כיולדה ; compare see 9), Jer 4:31 . b. figurative, be in severe pain , or anguish (mostly in poetry and elevated prose), followed by מפני Deut 2:25 (|| רגז , compare also מַּחַד and יִרְאָה v a ); Ezek 30:16 ; Psa 96:9 ; Jer 5:22 (|| ירא ); followed by מִלִּפְנֵי 1Chr 16:30 ; Psa 114:7 ; absolute 55:5 (|| עלי נפלו מָוֶת אימות ), Jer 4:19 Kt, Psa 77:17 (|| רגז ) 97:4 ; Isa 13:8 ; 23:5 ; Jer 51:29 (|| רָעַשׁ ), Joel 2:6 ; Zech 9:5 (|| ירא ), probably also 1Sam 31:3 (compare 28:5 ) = 1Chr 10:3 , compare Öttli; figurative of mountains Hab 3:10 . c. in contrition Jer 5:3 , חָ֫לוּ derived from חול Ew Gf Gie; < ᵑ6 Ra Hi Ke and others from חלה (wrongly accented; see חלה Qal 2 ). d. in anxious longing בּוֺשׁ עַד Judg 3:25 , followed by לְ Micah 1:12 (on Gen 8:10 , compare above) 3 whirl, whirl about יוֺאָב עַלרֿאֹשׁ (i.e. blood — דמים — of Abner, from sword) 2Sam 3:29 ; of attack of sword itself Hosea 11:6 (|| אכל כִּלָּה, ), compare Lam 4:6 ידים בה חָ֫לוּ לא ; of tempest יחול רשׁעים ראשׁ על Jer 23:19 (v:a מִתְחוֺלֵל סער ) = 30:23 (v:a מִתְגּוֺרֵר סַעַר ). Po`lel. Imperfect יְחוֺלֵל Psa 29:9 ; 3 feminine singular תְּחוֺלֵל Prov 25:23 ; suffix תְּחוֺלֶלְכֶם Isa 51:2 ; 2 masculine singular תְּחוֺלֵל Job 35:14 ; וַתְּחוֺלֵל Psa 90:2 ; Infinitive construct חֹלֵל Job 39:1 ; Participle מְחוֺלֵל Prov 26:10 ; מְחֹלֶלְךָ Deut 32:18 ; מְחֹלְלֶוֺת Judg 21:23 ; — 1Sam 18:6 ; Psa 87:7 see below; on חֹלְלָה Job 26:13 see חלל ; — 1 dance Judg 21:23 , so perhaps also 1Sam 18:6 (read ᵐ5 הַמְּחֹלְלוֺת We Dr; and חֹלֲלִים participle ( מ omitted) Psa 87:7 RV Pe De Che Bae; compare Qal 1 ). 2 writhe in travail with, bear, bring forth (poetry), of Sarah, mother of Israel, Isa 51:2 (|| אֲבִיכֶם אַבְרָהָם ); of hinds Job 39:1 ; Psa 29:9 (causative ); figurative of ׳י s producing earth 90:2 (|| יֻלָּד֑וּ ); of his bringing forth Israel (with difficulty, see Di) Deut 32:18 of north wind bringing forth rain Prov 25:23 ; כִּ֑ל מְחוֺלֵל רַב 26:10 a master produceth everything (on transitive see VB; Ew and others derive from חלל wound ). 3 wait anxiously (compare Qal 2 d ), followed by לְ Job 35:14 (Elihu).
